description: A single-panel TTT (time–temperature–transformation) diagram for the decomposition of the γ solid solution in a Fe-28Mn-8.5Al-1C-1.25Si alloy during isothermal aging. The y-axis is Temperature (°C), linear, with printed ticks at 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900 and 1000; the x-axis is Time (h), logarithmic, with decade ticks labelled 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100 and 1000. Five numbered reaction areas are separated by C-shaped transformation curves: 1: γ (a dashed curve occupying the lowest temperature / shortest time corner, ~400–700 °C and 0.01–0.5 h), 2: γ+κ′, 3: γ+κ′+κ*, 4: γ+κ′+κ*+α(B2/DO3) (the largest C-curve, from ~900 °C down to ~530 °C at 0.01–30 h), and 5: γ+κ+B2/DO3 (the right-hand C-curve at long times, ~630–870 °C, 20–500 h). An additional curve labelled γ caps the diagram near 940 °C. Four horizontal dashed lines mark reaction boundaries, and a right-hand vertical axis annotates the temperature ranges as B2 (top), B2+DO3 (middle) and DO3 (bottom). The figure establishes the sequence spinodal decomposition → homogeneous κ′ precipitation → grain-boundary κ* → discontinuous α(B2/DO3) → equilibrium B2+DO3 phases.

observations.observation: The plot is a TTT diagram with Temperature (°C) on the linear y-axis (printed ticks 300–1000, 100 °C steps) and Time (h) on the logarithmic x-axis (printed ticks 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000).
Five numbered reaction areas are labelled in the figure: '1: γ', '2: γ+κ′', '3: γ+κ′+κ*', '4: γ+κ′+κ*+α(B2/DO3)' and '5: γ+κ+B2/DO3'.
A separate curve labelled 'γ' caps the diagram, running roughly horizontally between the 900 and 1000 °C gridlines from about 0.03 h to about 10 h.
Area 1 is bounded by a dashed curve lying at the lowest temperatures, extending from the 700 °C line at 0.01 h down to about 400 °C near 0.5 h.
Area 5 (γ+κ+B2/DO3) is bounded by a C-curve on the right-hand side that is only reached at long times, spanning roughly 20–500 h between about 630 °C and 870 °C.
A right-hand vertical annotation band divides the temperature range into three parts labelled, from top to bottom, 'B2', 'B2+DO3' and 'DO3'.
Four horizontal dashed lines cross the diagram marking reaction boundaries; no numeric temperature values are printed on them.
The caption states that Area 1 corresponds to spinodal decomposition (chemical modulation) of the γ solid solution.
The caption states that Area 2 is homogeneous matrix κ-carbide precipitation, γ+κ′, and Area 3 is the formation of grain-boundary κ*-carbide, γ+κ′+κ*.
The caption states that Area 4 is a discontinuous reaction product of grain-boundary α(B2/DO3), γ+κ′+κ*+α(B2/DO3), and Area 5 contains all equilibrium phases, γ+κ+DO3+B2.
The citing text states that the TTT diagram was established for isothermal annealing between 400 and 950 °C for up to 1000 h for the Fe-28Mn-8.5Al-1C-1.25Si alloy.
The citing text states that aging below 500 °C greatly extends the time required for grain-boundary κ* precipitation, consistent with the area-3 curve shifting to longer times at low temperature.
The citing text states that Si eliminates β-Mn formation but promotes B2 and/or DO3 precipitates, which matches the B2/B2+DO3/DO3 ranges annotated on the right of the diagram.
